### Sommerspiele

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

  icon = "people-fill",
  color = col_summer,
  value = fmt_n(stats_summer$n_total)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

  title = paste0("Frauen ", stats_summer$latest_year),

  )
)
```

```{r}

    fmt_n(stats_summer$n_women_first), " (",

  )
)
```

## Row {height=60%}


### Column
```{r}
#| title: "Frauenanteil bei Olympischen Spielen über Zeit"
p <- ggplot(gender_by_year_female, aes(x = Year, y = share, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Summer" = col_summer, "Winter" = col_winter)) +
  labs(
    x = "Jahr",
    y = "Anteil weiblicher Athlet:innen",
    color = "Saison"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(p)
```


# Nach Sportart

## Row {.tabset}

### Nach Sportart über Zeit

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(gender_by_sport_mixed, aes(x = Year, y = share, group = Sport, text = Sport, color = Sport)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    x = "Jahr",
    y = "Frauenanteil",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(p2, tooltip = "text")
```

**Hinweis:** Reine Frauensportarten (z.B. Synchronschwimmen, Rhythmische Sportgymnastik) sowie reine Männersportarten sind hier nicht dargestellt, da ihr Anteil konstant bei 100 % bzw. 0 % liegt und keine Entwicklung zeigt.

```{r}
p3 <- gender_by_sport_current |> 
  mutate(Sport = fct_reorder(Sport, share)) |> 
  mutate(tooltip_text = paste0(
    Sport, " (", Season, ", ", Year, ")\n",
    "Frauenanteil: ", scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)
  )) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = share, y = Sport, fill = Season, text = tooltip_text)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Summer" = "#E69F00", "Winter" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "Frauenanteil (aktuellstes Jahr)", y = NULL, fill = "Saison") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7)

ggplotly(p3, tooltip = "text")
```
